description: Defines the FileUploadResult class, a value object representing the result of a file upload, including filename info, security flags, associated file entity, and validation violations.

classes.name: FileUploadResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a file upload, including filename details, security status, associated file entity, and validation violations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of FileUploadResult with an empty list of violations.

methods.name: setSecurityRename
methods.description: Flags the upload result as having a security rename.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Associates a FileInterface entity with the upload result.

methods.name: isSecurityRename
methods.description: Checks if the filename was renamed for security reasons.

methods.name: isRenamed
methods.description: Checks if the filename was renamed.

methods.name: addViolation
methods.description: Adds a constraint violation to the list.

methods.name: getViolations
methods.description: Retrieves the list of constraint violations.

methods.name: hasViolations
methods.description: Checks if there are any constraint violations.
